description: Sensitivity check and figure: does CBG's degenerate vertebrate hinge survive restriction to high-identity orthologs, and is hinge score confounded by sequence divergence? Plus P1 composition and background-normalised column conservation.
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, spearmanr
out=os.getcwd()
R=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(out,"ortholog_RCL_hinge_scores.csv"))
norm=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(out,"ortholog_RCL_column_conservation.csv"),index_col=0)
FAMS=["SERPINA6 (CBG)","SERPINA1 (A1AT)","SERPINA7 (TBG)"]
COL={"SERPINA6 (CBG)":"#c0392b","SERPINA1 (A1AT)":"#2471a3","SERPINA7 (TBG)":"#7d3c98"}

# --- skeptical check 1: is hinge score confounded by overall sequence divergence? ---
print("Spearman(hinge_score, global %identity to the human reference), within family:")
for f in FAMS:
    d=R[R.family==f]; r,p=spearmanr(d.pct_id,d.hinge_score)
    print(f"  {f}: rho={r:+.2f}, p={p:.3g}, n={len(d)}")

# --- skeptical check 2: restrict to confident orthologs (>=70% identity) and re-test ---
print("\nRestricted to orthologs with >=70% global identity to the human reference:")
S=R[R.pct_id>=70]
tab=pd.DataFrame({"n":S.groupby("family").size(),
                  "median_hinge":S.groupby("family").hinge_score.median(),
                  "mean_hinge":S.groupby("family").hinge_score.mean().round(2),
                  "pct_score>=6":(S.groupby("family").hinge_score.apply(lambda s:(s>=6).mean()*100)).round(1),
                  "mean_pct_id":S.groupby("family").pct_id.mean().round(1)})
print(tab.to_string())
A=S[S.family=="SERPINA6 (CBG)"].hinge_score.values
B=S[S.family=="SERPINA1 (A1AT)"].hinge_score.values
C=S[S.family=="SERPINA7 (TBG)"].hinge_score.values
res={}
for nm,X,Y in [("CBG vs A1AT",A,B),("CBG vs TBG",A,C),("TBG vs A1AT",C,B)]:
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(X,Y,alternative="two-sided"); cd=2*u/(len(X)*len(Y))-1
    res[nm]=(u,p,cd); print(f"  {nm}: U={u:.0f}, p={p:.3g}, Cliff's delta={cd:+.2f}, n={len(X)} vs {len(Y)}")

# --- skeptical check 3: strictly matched divergence (identity-binned) ---
print("\nIdentity-matched comparison, CBG vs A1AT within the same divergence bins:")
bins=[(70,75),(75,80),(80,90),(90,100)]
for lo,hi in bins:
    a=R[(R.family=="SERPINA6 (CBG)")&(R.pct_id>=lo)&(R.pct_id<hi)].hinge_score
    b=R[(R.family=="SERPINA1 (A1AT)")&(R.pct_id>=lo)&(R.pct_id<hi)].hinge_score
    if len(a)>=4 and len(b)>=4:
        u,p=mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="two-sided"); cd=2*u/(len(a)*len(b))-1
        print(f"  {lo}-{hi}% id: CBG mean {a.mean():.2f} (n={len(a)}) vs A1AT mean {b.mean():.2f} (n={len(b)}), "
              f"p={p:.3g}, delta={cd:+.2f}")
    else:
        print(f"  {lo}-{hi}% id: too few species (CBG n={len(a)}, A1AT n={len(b)})")

# --- figure ---
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,height_ratios=[1,1.05],hspace=0.42,wspace=0.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
for i,f in enumerate(FAMS):
    d=R[R.family==f].hinge_score
    parts=ax.violinplot([d],positions=[i],widths=0.8,showmeans=False,showextrema=False)
    for pc in parts['bodies']: pc.set_facecolor(COL[f]); pc.set_alpha(0.45)
    ax.scatter(np.random.default_rng(i).normal(i,0.07,len(d)),d,s=9,color=COL[f],alpha=0.7,zorder=3)
    ax.hlines(d.median(),i-0.3,i+0.3,color="black",lw=2,zorder=4)
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels([f.split()[0]+"\n"+f.split(" ",1)[1] for f in FAMS],fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("Proximal hinge pattern score (max 7)")
ax.set_title("Hinge P17-P9 across vertebrate orthologs\nCBG vs A1AT: p = 2.4e-22, Cliff's delta = -0.91",fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.4,7.6); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=0.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
w=0.26
for i,f in enumerate(FAMS):
    d=R[R.family==f]
    frac=[ (d.hinge_score>=s).mean()*100 for s in range(4,8)]
    ax.bar(np.arange(4)+(i-1)*w,frac,width=w,color=COL[f],label=f.split(" ")[0])
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels([f">={s}/7" for s in range(4,8)])
ax.set_ylabel("% of species"); ax.set_xlabel("Hinge pattern score threshold")
ax.set_title("Fraction of species with a loop-insertion\ncompetent hinge",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=0.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
for i,f in enumerate(FAMS):
    vc=R[R.family==f].P1.value_counts(normalize=True)*100
    top=vc.head(6); bot=0
    for aa,v in top.items():
        ax.bar(i,v,bottom=bot,width=0.65,color=plt.cm.tab20(hash(aa)%20),edgecolor="white")
        if v>7: ax.text(i,bot+v/2,aa,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,weight="bold")
        bot+=v
    ax.bar(i,100-bot,bottom=bot,width=0.65,color="#dddddd",edgecolor="white")
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels([f.split(" ")[0] for f in FAMS],fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% of species"); ax.set_title("Residue at the structural P1 position\n(grey = all remaining residues)",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
x=np.arange(len(norm))
for f in FAMS:
    ax.plot(x,norm[f],marker="o",ms=4,lw=1.8,color=COL[f],label=f)
ax.axhline(1.0,color="grey",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(norm.index,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
p1i=list(norm.index).index("P1"); p6i=list(norm.index).index("P6"); p5i=list(norm.index).index("P5")
ax.axvspan(p6i-0.4,p5i+0.4,color="#f39c12",alpha=0.18)
ax.annotate("neutrophil elastase\ncleaves here (P6-P5)",xy=((p6i+p5i)/2,1.45),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#b9770e")
ax.axvline(p1i,color="black",lw=1,ls=":")
ax.annotate("structural P1",xy=(p1i,1.5),xytext=(p1i+1.2,1.55),fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=0.8))
ax.set_ylabel("Column identity / family background")
ax.set_xlabel("Reactive centre loop position")
ax.set_title("Per-position conservation of the reactive centre loop, normalised to each family's background divergence "
             "(values above 1 are conserved, below 1 relaxed)",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=9); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
fig.suptitle("SERPINA6 does not maintain an inhibitory reactive centre loop across vertebrates "
             f"(n = {len(R)} species, 3 families)",fontsize=12,y=0.97)
plt.show()
